description: A cafe project composing cafe-ops with bookkeeping. Only this file, read at its committed revision, binds people and event signer groups, enables the supplier tool, the weekly schedule and automatic spawns, sets the data policy, decides which manager acts may be delegated to the orchestrator, names the cafe managers as the confirmers of process changes (spec section 2.4; how they confirm is spec/trust.md in relux-works/curator-trust) and decides which human acts need signatures (the cafe demo follows the waggle amendment, CM2, and PC3). Principals follow waggle; the service kind svc: comes with the waggle amendment (spec section 17). Tools the project does not list in policy.enable.tools stay disabled.

supplier-bridge.description: Verifies the supplier portal's webhook signature before it signs supplier events.

payment-bridge.description: Verifies the payment provider's webhook signature before it signs payment events.

wip.description: No more than five orders wait for a manager at once: a limit on a human-owned state.

allow.description: A manager may let their own orchestrator sessions approve purchase orders up to 1,000 EUR; a granted delegation may be stricter, for example 500 EUR per order and 2,000 EUR a week. The orchestrator's buyer runs draft the orders and may write amount, which the ceiling reads, only while an order is in draft, its initial state (spec section 5.2); the rule therefore allows the delegate to approve orders its own runs filled in. Inventory approvals stay with the managers.
The orchestrator may then send the approved order on the manager's behalf.

never.description: A supplier problem and the receipt of goods always need a manager.
